name: create_livecall_booking
description: Creates the live call booking on Cal.com. CRITICAL: pass `time` as {{selected_time}} VERBATIM (the chosen slot's `time` value, bare local time in the prospect's zone — never recompute it, never use a UTC `iso`). Send `timezone` as {{prospect_timezone}} in IANA format — it must be the SAME zone the `time` value is in. ALWAYS use email = jaydiallux@gmail.com (system shared attendee) and format phoneNumber to E.164 from {{callback_number}} before calling.

name: record_booking_uid
description: Immediately after create_livecall_booking responds, record its booking id/uid here VERBATIM from the response. If the response contained no id, leave it empty - never invent one.

variables.name: booking_uid
variables.description: The booking's id/uid copied verbatim from the create_livecall_booking response.

name: validate_booking
description: Post-booking schema gate. Call ONLY AFTER record_booking_uid. Validates every stored field incl. the recorded booking id. Returns {valid, problems}. Call it exactly ONCE.

name: extract_slot_result
description: Records the slot confirmation outcome. Set booking_verified = true ONLY when validate_booking returned valid: true. Set booking_failed = true ONLY after the retry also failed. Never set both.

variables.name: booking_verified
variables.description: true ONLY when validate_booking returned valid:true (calendar accepted + all fields schema-clean).

variables.name: booking_failed
variables.description: true ONLY when the calendar rejected the booking twice and the wrap-up fallback was spoken.

name: record_prospect_name
description: Capture first_name / last_name when you ask for them here because they were missing. Never invent values.

variables.name: first_name
variables.description: Caller's first name, exactly as they say it.

variables.name: last_name
variables.description: Caller's last name, exactly as they say it.
